changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0030. Let a Basic gym member and a trainer use the mobile AI coach. BASIC already carries the member operations features; this turns on the four AI features the coach screen calls. Trainer already reads fitness data; this adds the same manage and AI_USE grants the Member role uses for that screen. Index review: no new indexes. UX_PlanFeatures_PlanId_FeatureCode seeks the plan feature rows, and RolePermissions is keyed by role and permission. Performance note: both writes touch a handful of catalog rows.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE pf SET pf.[Enabled] = 1, pf.UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() FROM app.PlanFeatures pf INNER JOIN app.Plans p ON p.Id = pf.PlanId WHERE p.Code = N'BASIC' AND pf.FeatureCode IN (N'AI_COACH', N'AI_NUTRITION', N'AI_WORKOUT_GENERATION', N'AI_PROGRESS_INSIGHTS');
INSERT INTO app.RolePermissions (RoleId, PermissionId) SELECT r.Id, p.Id FROM app.Roles r INNER JOIN app.Permissions p ON p.Code IN ( N'FITNESS_MANAGE', N'WORKOUT_MANAGE', N'NUTRITION_READ', N'NUTRITION_MANAGE', N'AI_USE') WHERE r.Name = N'Trainer' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app.RolePermissions existing WHERE existing.RoleId = r.Id AND existing.PermissionId = p.Id);

rollback.sql: UPDATE pf SET pf.[Enabled] = 0 FROM app.PlanFeatures pf INNER JOIN app.Plans p ON p.Id = pf.PlanId WHERE p.Code = N'BASIC' AND pf.FeatureCode IN (N'AI_COACH', N'AI_NUTRITION', N'AI_WORKOUT_GENERATION', N'AI_PROGRESS_INSIGHTS'); DELETE rp FROM app.RolePermissions rp INNER JOIN app.Roles r ON r.Id = rp.RoleId AND r.Name = N'Trainer' INNER JOIN app.Permissions p ON p.Id = rp.PermissionId WHERE p.Code IN (N'FITNESS_MANAGE', N'WORKOUT_MANAGE', N'NUTRITION_READ', N'NUTRITION_MANAGE', N'AI_USE');
